text:
Analysts See $2.19 EPS for Zimmer Biomet Holdings, Inc. (ZBH) Posted by Vivian Park 9:00 pm
Analysts expect Zimmer Biomet Holdings, Inc. (NYSE:ZBH) to report $2.19 EPS on January, 29.They anticipate $0.09 EPS change or 4.29 % from last quarter’s $2.1 EPS. ZBH’s profit would be $446.70M giving it 11.72 P/E if the $2.19 EPS is correct. After having $1.63 EPS previously, Zimmer Biomet Holdings, Inc.’s analysts see 34.36 % EPS growth. The stock increased 0.92% or $0.94 $102.65. About 1.86M shares traded or 44.96% up from the average. Zimmer Biomet Holdings, Inc. (NYSE:ZBH) has declined 3.21% downtrending. It has underperformed by 3.21% the S&P500. Zimmer Biomet Holdings, Inc. (NYSE:ZBH) Ratings Coverage
Among 14 analysts covering Zimmer Biomet Holdings ( NYSE:ZBH ), 7 have Buy rating, 2 Sell and 5 Hold. Therefore 50% are positive. Zimmer Biomet Holdings had 16 analyst reports since July 30, 2018 according to SRatingsIntel. On Monday, October 29 the stock rating was maintained by Jefferies with “Buy”. The stock of Zimmer Biomet Holdings, Inc. (NYSE:ZBH) earned “Neutral” rating by Robert W. Baird on Monday, July 30. The stock has “Overweight” rating by Morgan Stanley on Thursday, October 11. The rating was downgraded by JP Morgan on Wednesday, December 19 to “Neutral”. Canaccord Genuity maintained Zimmer Biomet Holdings, Inc. (NYSE:ZBH) rating on Monday, July 30. Canaccord Genuity has “Hold” rating and $125 target. The rating was maintained by Barclays Capital with “Underweight” on Monday, October 29. Raymond James maintained the stock with “Outperform” rating in Monday, July 30 report. The stock of Zimmer Biomet Holdings, Inc. (NYSE:ZBH) has “Market Outperform” rating given on Monday, July 30 by JMP Securities. The stock of Zimmer Biomet Holdings, Inc. (NYSE:ZBH) earned “Buy” rating by Needham on Monday, August 13. As per Monday, July 30, the company rating was maintained by Cantor Fitzgerald.
Zimmer Biomet Holdings, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, designs, makes, and markets musculoskeletal healthcare products and solutions in the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and the Asia Pacific. The company has market cap of $20.94 billion. It operates through four divisions: Americas Spine, Office Based Technologies, Craniomaxillofacial and Thoracic , and Dental. It has a 11.98 P/E ratio. The firm provides orthopedic reconstructive products, such as knee and hip reconstructive products; S.E.T. products, including surgical, sports medicine, biologics, foot and ankle, extremities, and trauma products; spine products comprising medical devices and surgical instruments; and face and skull reconstruction products, as well as products that fixate and stabilize the bones of the chest to facilitate healing or reconstruction after open heart surgery, trauma, or for deformities of the chest.
